content.text: Lots of kids Milo's age still co-sleep, and a gradual move usually goes better than a sudden one. Start tonight by doing his bedtime routine in his own room. Then stay with him in a chair next to his bed until he's drowsy, and leave once he's calm. Once that feels easy, move the chair a bit closer to the door every few nights. He keeps the comfort of you being there, but he learns to fall asleep in his own bed.
